title: What's New at Devyce? Dec 2025
summary: This month we have made a series of updates focused on making your data sync faster and more reliably to your CRM as well as giving the team smarter call routing and dial out options.
body_markdown:
You’re not just using a phone system, you’re part of a growing community of businesses choosing to work smarter and more flexibly with Devyce. And we are so glad you’re on this journey with us!


This month we have made a series of updates focused on making your data sync faster and more reliably to your CRM as well as giving the team smarter call routing and dial out options.


### **Here’s what’s new**


#
**CRM sync status**


‍


‍


Teams users can now check the status of their AI call notes sync and where they’re stored. Everything stays up to date and editable with one click.


[Find out more](https://devyce-knowledge-base.help.usepylon.com/articles/3251717447-how-to-check-your-crm-sync-status)


‍


# **Deskphones**


‍


‍


Add a Devyce-enabled desk phone to your workspace.Some tools never go out of style. Speak to your account manager to find out more.


Contact us


‍


# **Default SMS numbers**


‍


‍


Use one number for calls and another for messages — simple and flexible.


[Find out more](https://devyce-knowledge-base.help.usepylon.com/articles/4598104469-setting-a-default-phone-number-and-default-sms-numbersoft-phone)


‍


# **Smarter call routing**


‍


‍


With Devyce’s warm transfer feature, you can speak with a colleague before passing on a call — helping you give clients a smoother, more professional experience. Warm transfers are available now, book in a call or register your interest in a plan upgrade with your account manager.


Contact us


‍


‍


# We’re here to help


‍


Please let our team know if you have any questions or comments. We always try to work on your feedback as quickly as possible.


Contact Us
